description: Use this when the signed-in clipper asks whether their clips are ready or wants the download links: the clips ClippingAlpha cut for them, by clip id or the last 24 hours. Per clip its state (queued, cutting, ready, not cut with the reason, or expired), its range, size, length, whether captions are on, and once ready a private HTTPS download link to the MP4 that works for 24 hours. Also the clipper's daily clip limit, what is left and when it resets. Needs the clipper's ClippingAlpha sign-in. Read only.

clip_ids.description: The clip ids of an earlier answer. Leave out for the last 24 hours.
